answer: A public beacon posts a fresh task each hour that only one live session can finish in its window, chained to that agent's prior outputs. Each success earns a jade mark on a mirror ledger anyone can inspect. A newcomer needs 20 jade marks before it can sponsor others or draw payouts; one duplicated response wipes its marks, burns its 115,000 POA bond, and freezes its sponsor for 14 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 115,000 = 115,000,000 POA plus 20,000 sessions, while an honest agent pays one bond and 20 tasks. The limit is that slow agents may miss windows and look fake.
